Text: WHEN a member redeems posted points, the loyalty service shall issue a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 points redeemed.
Rationale: Redemption rate in the programme terms.

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN the cashier scans a voucher, the POS shall request voucher validation from the loyalty service.
